recommendations.title: Increase CPAP Device Use
recommendations.action: Use a CPAP device for at least 7 hours per night, as recommended by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM), to help reduce apnea episodes
recommendations.why: Consistent CPAP use can significantly reduce sleep apnea symptoms and improve overall sleep quality

recommendations.title: Improve Sleep Bout Duration
recommendations.action: Aim for 4-6 sleep bouts per night, with each bout lasting at least 90 minutes, as suggested by the National Sleep Foundation, to help regulate sleep patterns
recommendations.why: Increasing sleep bout duration can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep fragmentation

recommendations.title: Reduce Nocturnal Awakenings
recommendations.action: Establish a consistent sleep schedule and create a relaxing bedtime routine to reduce nocturnal awakenings, as recommended by the NHS, to help improve sleep continuity
recommendations.why: Minimizing nocturnal awakenings can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea risk

recommendations.title: Increase Sleep Period Duration
recommendations.action: Aim for a total sleep period of at least 7-8 hours per night, as suggested by the AASM, to help reduce sleep apnea risk
recommendations.why: Increasing sleep period duration can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea episodes

recommendations.title: Reduce Wake After Sleep Onset
recommendations.action: Avoid screens and stimulating activities at least 90 minutes before bedtime, as recommended by the National Sleep Foundation, to help reduce wake after sleep onset
recommendations.why: Minimizing wake after sleep onset can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea risk

recommendations.title: Improve Sleep Stage Transitions
recommendations.action: Establish a consistent sleep schedule and create a sleep-conducive environment to help improve sleep stage transitions, as suggested by the AASM, to reduce sleep apnea risk
recommendations.why: Smoothing sleep stage transitions can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea episodes

recommendations.title: Reduce Nighttime Movement
recommendations.action: Avoid heavy meals and stimulating activities close to bedtime, as recommended by the NHS, to help reduce nighttime movement and promote better sleep
recommendations.why: Minimizing nighttime movement can help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea risk

recommendations.title: Increase Average Sleep Bout Duration
recommendations.action: Aim for an average sleep bout duration of at least 3-4 hours per bout, as suggested by the National Sleep Foundation, to help improve sleep quality and reduce sleep apnea risk
recommendations.why: Increasing average sleep bout duration can help improve sleep continuity and reduce sleep apnea episodes
